message: Live frame analysis completed with OpenAI vision.

spec.workflowSummary: MVP: a narrow internal repair service ticket tracker for appliance issues reported over WhatsApp-like chat. Staff manually captures the customer report, assigns a technician and visit time, copies a technician notification template, then closes the ticket after the visit with status, charge, payment, and notes. No WhatsApp API or external integrations are included.

sourceEvidence.observation: Screen title says "Repair service ticket workflow". Card label "WhatsApp". Main step: "Customer reports appliance issue". Example details: "Rohit: My washing machine is leaking", "Address: Hitech City", "Available after 5 PM". Right observation panel partially shows structured fields including customer, issue, area, and priority.

Card label "Technician chat". Main step: "Assign and notify technician". Example details: "Assign to: Kiran", "Visit: Today 6 PM", "Part likely: inlet pipe". Right observation panel partially references a template.
Card label "Service sheet". Main step: "Close ticket after visit". Example details: "Status: Completed", "Charge: Rs 950", "Payment: Cash received", "Notes: pipe replaced".

steps.title: Capture customer appliance issue from WhatsApp message
steps.input: Customer message containing name, issue, address or area, and availability.
steps.output: Structured service ticket with customer name, issue description, address/area, availability, and optional priority.

steps.title: Assign technician and prepare visit notification
steps.input: Open ticket plus technician name, visit time, and likely required part.
steps.output: Ticket updated to assigned state and technician notification text ready to copy.

steps.title: Close ticket after service visit
steps.input: Technician visit outcome, final status, charge, payment information, and service notes.
steps.output: Ticket marked completed with charge, payment, and notes recorded.

entities.name: ServiceTicket

actions: Create service ticket from customer message
painPoints: Customer WhatsApp messages need to be converted into structured service ticket fields.
Technician assignment messages repeat the same visit details and likely part information.
Service closure details such as status, charge, payment, and notes need consistent capture after each visit.
Ticket information appears split across chat, technician notification, and service sheet steps.

validationRules.message: Charge must be a numeric amount.

clarifyingQuestions.question: Should priority use fixed values, or remain free text?
clarifyingQuestions.defaultAnswer: Keep priority as free text for MVP because no priority values are visible in the frames.

clarifyingQuestions.question: Should customer phone number be captured?
clarifyingQuestions.defaultAnswer: No for MVP because no phone number appears in the sampled frames.

clarifyingQuestions.question: Should charges be stored in INR/Rs?
clarifyingQuestions.defaultAnswer: Use Rs/INR by default because the frame shows "Rs 950".
